datePolicy: Original hands-on measurement and public-source research were recorded on 2026-11-06. All cited URLs inherit that recorded access date from sources.md and its dated research appendix. Localization on 2026-11-06 did not refresh sources, rerun synthesis or audition audio.
uncertainties: No human audition or cloud listening assessment. Naturalness, tone, emotion and human comprehension are unassessed; WER measures a TTS-plus-ASR pipeline, not perceptual quality.
Only five short original English scripts and one tested voice per engine. Catalogue Mandarin availability does not validate Chinese or non-English operation in this exact wrapper.

Tested Piper Lessac model rights are ambiguous: global MIT metadata conflicts with the exact card linking research-only dataset terms. Dataset terms alone do not determine all trained-model/output rights.

Apple Tahoe English page 3 section 2F restricts original system-voice content to personal noncommercial use and excludes public sharing, nonprofit publishing and commercial contexts; accompanying installation terms may differ.
One pass per tool/script on a shared Apple M2. Timings include process/model startup and may reflect caches and concurrent workloads. CPU ONNX only; no controlled throughput or uncertainty estimate.
RSS sampled every 20 ms can miss peaks and is not unified-memory pressure. say can use a pre-existing OS daemon outside the measured child tree; its RSS is incomplete.

Whisper small.en executable upstream revision is unverified; binary hash recorded by original test. Raw/normalized WER can hide or penalize pronunciation differences; low or zero WER does not prove meaning or emotion.
Installer syntax checked only; helper smoke-tested with existing dependencies/assets, not a full fresh-install rerun. Tested model-files-v1.0 export differs from newer exports with similar filenames.
No new external research, package installs, model execution, media uploads, publication or contact for this guide.
editingContract: Complete en/zh drafts with identical date-normalized numeric and URL multiplicity and corresponding table-cell numeric parity. All 25 measured tool/script rows retain report-level performance, both RSS measures, bytes, sample rate and raw/normalized WER. No ratings or review markup. Original stage2-relative document links retained.
